summary: Primech Holdings Ltd., a Singapore-based foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K dated September 1, 2026 containing its Notice and Proxy Statement for the Annual General Meeting scheduled for October 14, 2026. The filing is solely a routine meeting notice with proxy voting instructions for ordinary business such as adopting financial statements. No special-situation event such as acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or management change is involved. The record date is August 20, 2026. As a routine proxy circular, this does not qualify as a special situation.
